required.quote: Renewal qualifications shall include: (a) either documentation of current and active NCCAOM certification; or (b) meeting the same professional development requirements as those licensed under this chapter.
required.citation: Section 303 - Terms of license -- Expiration -- Renewal.

available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing in the other state, district, or territory where the license was issued.
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state/territory with similar scope, have at least one year of experience under that license, and the license must be in good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 302

exists.quote: There is created an Acupuncture Licensing Board consisting of: (a) four licensed acupuncturists; and (b) one member from the general public.

title_protection.quote: A person practicing as a licensed acupuncturist may not display or in any way use any title, words, or insignia in conjunction with the person's name or practice except the words "licensed acupuncturist" or "L.Ac.".
title_protection.citation: Section 501 - Acupuncture licensee -- Restriction on titles used.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or rule, including failure to transmit records in English upon request.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct includes the failure to transmit records in the English language to the division, the patient's practitioner, or a third party insurance payor upon request.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlawful conduct as defined by statute, including practicing without a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or engaging in, representing oneself to be practicing or engaging in, or attempting to practice or engage in any profession requiring licensure under this title... if the person is: (i) not licensed to do so or not exempted from licensure under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a license through fraud, forgery, or intentional deception.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining a passing score on a licensure examination, applying for or obtaining a license, or otherwise dealing with the division or a licensing board through the use of fraud, forgery, or intentional deception, misrepresentation, misstatement, or omission
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has been determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 401

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction, plea of nolo contendere, or guilty plea for a crime substantially related to the ability to safely practice the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in conduct that results in conviction, a plea of nolo contendere, or a plea of guilty or nolo contendere that is held in abeyance pending the successful completion of probation with respect to a crime that, when considered with the functions and duties of the profession for which the license was issued or is to be issued, bears a substantial relationship to the licensee's or applicant's ability to safely or competently practice the profession
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing through gross incompetence, gross negligence, or a pattern of incompetency or negligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title through gross incompetence, gross negligence, or a pattern of incompetency or negligence
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing beyond the scope of the licensee's license or competency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession regulated under this title beyond the scope of the licensee's license
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Verbally, physically, mentally, or sexually abusing or exploiting any person through conduct connected with the licensee's practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: verbally, physically, mentally, or sexually abusing or exploiting any person through conduct connected with the licensee's practice under this title or otherwise facilitated by the licensee's license
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing by any form of communication that is false, misleading, deceptive, or fraudulent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: practicing or attempting to practice a profession requiring licensure under this title by any form of action or communication which is false, misleading, deceptive, or fraudulent
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by another licensing authority for conduct that would constitute grounds for denial or discipline in Utah.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in conduct that results in disciplinary action, including reprimand, censure, diversion, probation, suspension, or revocation, by any other licensing or regulatory authority having jurisdiction over the licensee or applicant in the same profession if the conduct would, in this state, constitute grounds for denial of licensure or disciplinary proceedings
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act, Section 501

definition_quote.value: 'Practice of acupuncture' means the insertion of acupuncture needles, the use of injection therapy, and the application of moxibustion to specific areas of the body based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research as a primary mode of therapy.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of acupuncture" means the insertion of acupuncture needles, the use of injection therapy, and the application of moxibustion to specific areas of the body based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research as a primary mode of therapy.

value: manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments
recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise
methods_authorized.quote: Adjunctive therapies within the scope of the practice of acupuncture may include: (i) manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research; (ii) the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training

drug_authority.value: A licensee who has received necessary training including a clean needle technique certificate from NCCAOM has authority to procure and administer prescriptive substances (nutritional substances, local anesthetics, autologous blood, sterile water, dextrose, sodium bicarbonate, and sterile saline) for in-office administration only via injection therapy.
drug_authority.quote: A licensee who has received the necessary training to practice injection therapy, including having obtained a clean needle technique certificate from the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM): (a) has authority to procure and administer prescriptive substances described in Subsections 58-72-102(2)(a) and (b) for in-office administration only

herbal_therapy_authorized.quote: the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training

injection_therapy_authorized.quote: "Injection therapy" means the use of a hypodermic needle, by a licensed acupuncturist who has obtained a clean needle technique certificate from the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM), to inject any of the following sterile substances in liquid form into acupuncture points on the body subcutaneously or intramuscularly

value: autologous blood (if the licensee holds a current phlebotomy certification to draw blood)
injection_therapy_permitted_substances.quote: to inject any of the following sterile substances in liquid form into acupuncture points on the body subcutaneously or intramuscularly: (i) a nutritional substance; (ii) a local anesthetic; (iii) autologous blood, if the licensee holds a current phlebotomy certification to draw blood; (iv) sterile water; (v) dextrose; (vi) sodium bicarbonate; and (vii) sterile saline.

injection_therapy_excluded_sites.quote: "Injection therapy" does not include injecting a substance into a vein, joint, artery, blood vessel, nerve, tendon, deep organ, or the spine.

value: child under the age of eight
injection_therapy_patient_exclusions.quote: "Injection therapy" may not be performed on a pregnant woman or a child under the age of eight.

value: manual treatments based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research
practice on animals to the extent permitted by Subsection 58-28-307(12), the provisions of this chapter, and division rule
adjunctive_therapies_authorized.quote: Adjunctive therapies within the scope of the practice of acupuncture may include: (i) manual, mechanical, thermal, electrical, light, and electromagnetic treatments based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research; (ii) the recommendation, administration, or provision of dietary guidelines, herbs, supplements, homeopathics, and therapeutic exercise based on traditional oriental medical diagnosis and modern research according to practitioner training; and (iii) the practice described in Subsections (5)(a) and (b) on an animal to the extent permitted by: (A) Subsection 58-28-307(12); (B) the provisions of this chapter; and (C) division rule.

value: manual manipulation or adjustment of the joints of the body beyond the elastic barrier
manipulation of the articulation of the spinal column as defined in Section 58-73-102
scope_exclusions.quote: "Practice of acupuncture" does not include: (i) the manual manipulation or adjustment of the joints of the body beyond the elastic barrier; or (ii) the "manipulation of the articulation of the spinal column" as defined in Section 58-73-102.

animal_acupuncture_permitted.quote: the practice described in Subsections (5)(a) and (b) on an animal to the extent permitted by: (A) Subsection 58-28-307(12); (B) the provisions of this chapter; and (C) division rule.

value: individual described in Section 58-1-602 performing a procedure described in that section
physician and surgeon or osteopathic physician and surgeon licensed under Chapter 67 or 68
commissioned physician or surgeon serving in the armed forces or other federal agency
chiropractic physician licensed under Chapter 73 (except may not claim to be a licensed acupuncturist without acupuncturist licensure)
licensure_exempt_professions.quote: the following individuals may engage in the practice of acupuncture subject to the stated circumstances and limitations without being licensed under this chapter: (1) an individual described in Section 58-1-602 who is performing a procedure described in Section 58-1-602; (2) an individual licensed as a physician and surgeon or osteopathic physician and surgeon under Chapter 67, Utah Medical Practice Act, and Chapter 68, Utah Osteopathic Medical Practice Act; (3) a commissioned physician or surgeon serving in the armed forces of the United States or other federal agency; and (4) a chiropractic physician licensed under Chapter 73, Chiropractic Physician Practice Act, except that a chiropractic physician may not claim to be a licensed acupuncturist without acupuncturist licensure.

nccaom_certification_required.quote: meet the requirements for current active certification in acupuncture under guidelines established by the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM) as demonstrated through a current certificate or other appropriate documentation

clean_needle_technique_certificate_requi.quote: "Injection therapy" means the use of a hypodermic needle, by a licensed acupuncturist who has obtained a clean needle technique certificate from the National Commission for the Certification of Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine (NCCAOM)

informed_consent_required.quote: establish procedures, as defined by rule, which shall enable patients to give informed consent to treatment

title_restrictions.quote: A person practicing as a licensed acupuncturist may not display or in any way use any title, words, or insignia in conjunction with the person's name or practice except the words "licensed acupuncturist" or "L.Ac.". ... A licensed acupuncturist may not use the term "physician," "physician or surgeon," or "doctor" in conjunction with the acupuncturist's name or practice.
title_restrictions.citation: Section 501 - Acupuncture licensee -- Restriction on titles used.

required_display_title.quote: the term "licensed acupuncturist" or "L.Ac." shall be displayed next to the name of the licensed acupuncturist.
required_display_title.citation: Section 501 - Acupuncture licensee -- Restriction on titles used.

medical_practice_not_authorized.quote: Nothing in this chapter may be construed to permit the practice of medicine nor require direct payment from third party insurers directly to a person engaged in the practice of acupuncture.
medical_practice_not_authorized.citation: Section 601 - Acupuncture license not authorizing medical practice -- Insurance payments.
